samples.execution_trace: Connection.connect establishes default certificate-validating TLS or a configured proxy, generates an RFC 6455 handshake key, and checks Sec-WebSocket-Accept via SHA-1 and compare_digest. _build_data_frame_for_sending builds FIN/opcode/length fields, generates four mask bytes, repeats that key with itertools.cycle, XORs payload bytes, and returns header plus masked payload; Connection sends those bytes to its peer. This is protocol framing, not concealed executable source. No eval/exec sink consumes the XOR result. Ordinary HTTP/proxy authentication, hashing, Base64, sockets, TLS and byte transforms remain detected.
